- Una: Prefers north office for reviews; covering for Leon.

- Library annex: Repainting (afternoon noise); coffee working; Ines prefers it; lift slow.
- North office: Coffee working.
- Kira: Out for rest of week; covered by Ines.
- Afternoon stand-up: Harbour room.
- Vik: Out; covered by Bram and Dell.
- Bram: Covering Vik, Pia, Leon; needs morning notes; finds harbour room too cold.
- Finn: Garden studio too cold (morning); print room too cold (evening).
- Dovdale fleet: Mileage cap 4,425.
- Dell: Covering Vik; needs evening notes; prefers library annex.
- Yormore fleet: Mileage cap 6,950; count 5,975.

- Lifts: Near east wing, library annex, loading bay, and print room are slow.
